name: musket-war
description: Browser-based multiplayer American Revolution PvP musket shooter

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p shared && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p client
scripts.build: npm run check && npm run build -w client
